eva_ml: Hey team - starting a quick bring-up of pica-v1 embedding with 6-bit quant (per-channel). Running a small sanity eval across english wiki + product FAQ holdouts. Posting initial numbers.

sam_engineer: Nice, what's the eval harness? recall@1/5/10? latency numbers?

eva_ml: recall@1=0.64, @5=0.81, @10=0.86 on the wiki holdout. For FAQ small set: @1=0.58, @5=0.78. Baseline fp16 pica-v1: @1=0.67, @5=0.84. So delta ~ -0.03 @1, -0.03 @5. Latency: 6-bit quant gives 1.5x throughput improvement in our microbatch path on A100.

maya_research: Can you paste the eval command and prompt preprocessing? Also were you using cosine or dot? Tiny differences matter.

eva_ml: Using cosine after L2 norm. Eval snippet:
```
python eval_recall.py --model pica-v1 --quant int6_per_channel --metric recall --k 10 --norm l2 --holdout wiki_faq --batch 256
```

maya_research: Thanks. Any clustering checks? silhouette or purity? We saw weird tight clusters with an earlier quant config.

eva_ml: Ran kmeans k=100, silhouette dropped 0.02 vs fp16 (0.41 -> 0.39). Purity on labeled subset stayed within 1.5%.

eval-bot: Automated eval complete: 1748888280 | recall@1 delta -0.03 | recall@5 delta -0.03 | silhouette delta -0.02 | throughput +50% | avg_token_latency -12ms | anomaly_flags: none

sam_engineer: Those deltas look ok for many customers but borderline for short-query FAQ. Can we run the short-query stratified test (queries length <= 30 chars)?

eva_ml: Running now, will push results in 10m. Early peek: short-query recall@1 dropped 0.07 (0.63 -> 0.56) on the FAQ set. Likely quantization saturating small vectors.

maya_research: Hmm. Could try per-channel + scale-clamp or asymmetric quant to help short vectors. Also try switching to cosine with temperature=0.01? (just kidding on temp, but small adjustments help normalization).

leo_ops: If this is a customer-facing regression we should gate it. Are we testing on Dedicated infra? Does the runtime fallback work to fp16 variant?

eva_ml: Yes, rollout plan: canary 5% to staging. Fallback policy already configured to fp16 pica-v1 if recall@1 on staging drop > 0.05 for short-query segment.

sam_engineer: Can you add a quick notebook with the failing examples (short queries + nearest neighbors) so we can inspect lexical vs semantic failures? That helps decide quant fix vs model tweak.

eva_ml: On it. I'll share gist in the thread. For next steps: run per-channel+clamp sweep, asymmetric quant baseline, and short-query focused rescaling. Will update results here. :mag:

maya_research: Thanks — please tag me when the sweep completes. If per-channel clamp fixes >0.04 delta, we can proceed to a wider canary.

eva_ml: Will do. Tagging @maya_research and @sam_engineer for follow-ups.
